$description: Virtualization (hooks/useVirtualizer.js, system/virtual.css): the size of one item of a virtualized collection, which the gaps standing in for unrendered items are measured in. A container sets both on itself in its own stylesheet to the size and gap its items have.

virtual-item-size.$description: One item's size along the scroll axis (a row's height, a column's width); a virtualized container sets it to its own item size (for a list: --plx-sys-data-grid-row-height)

virtual-item-gap.$description: The gap between two items along the scroll axis (the container's row-gap or column-gap)

virtual-sticky-background.$description: The surface behind a sticky group header of a virtualized list, so the items do not show through it

plenix.purpose: The background of a sticky item in a virtualized list.
